properties.name: simulator.enabled
properties.description: Enable/disable the transaction simulator on startup.

properties.name: simulator.interval-ms
properties.description: Interval in milliseconds between simulator runs.

properties.name: simulator.scenario-probability
properties.description: Probability [0..1] of generating a special scenario transaction.

properties.name: simulator.log-file
properties.description: Path to simulator output log file.

properties.name: groq.api.key
properties.description: Groq API key used by ChatbotService.

properties.name: groq.model
properties.description: Groq model name for chat completion requests.

properties.name: chatbot.knowledge-files
properties.description: Comma-separated list of knowledge file paths loaded by the chatbot.

properties.name: network.python.executable
properties.description: Python executable used to launch network analysis scripts.

properties.name: network.python.script-dir
properties.description: Directory that contains network-analysis Python scripts.

properties.name: network.python.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Max allowed runtime for Python network analysis invocation.

properties.name: app.investigation.email.override-enabled
properties.description: When true, investigation emails are delivered only to override-recipient for safe testing.

properties.name: app.investigation.email.override-recipient
properties.description: Destination mailbox used when investigation override-enabled is true.

properties.name: app.investigation.response.token-ttl-hours
properties.description: Validity period in hours for customer response tokens included in outreach messages.

properties.name: app.investigation.email.from
properties.description: Sender email address used for outbound investigation messages.

properties.name: app.investigation.email.mode
properties.description: Email delivery mode: 'stub' logs only, 'smtp' performs real SMTP send.
